module.name: repeated-escape
module.description: Detect publication across repeated loop iterations for persistent local containers.

specifications.feature: Detect publication across repeated loop iterations for persistent local containers.

scenarios.name: should detect repeated publication
scenarios.given: a container allocated outside a for, for-in, for-of, while, or do-while body
scenarios.when: a later reference publishes the container within the loop
scenarios.then: the write is treated as potentially observable on later iterations

scenarios.name: should allow per-iteration allocation
scenarios.given: a container initialized within the loop body
scenarios.then: the allocation remains local before publication in that iteration

scenarios.name: should handle nested loops
scenarios.given: a container allocated in an outer body and reused by an inner loop
scenarios.when: the inner loop publishes the container
scenarios.then: the write is treated as observable on later inner iterations

scenarios.name: should ignore later publication outside loops
scenarios.given: a container published only after its mutation loop
scenarios.then: the later publication does not imply an earlier escape

scenarios.name: should stop at function boundaries
scenarios.given: a write with no enclosing persistent loop
scenarios.then: the search ends at the function boundary
